---
title: Use a Jupyter Notebook
description: "Render Python notebook cells as a browser-run Gradio app while keeping Quarto-side execution disabled."
---

`quarto-gradio` can collect Python code cells from a Jupyter notebook and emit an embedded app in HTML output. A standalone notebook can put its Quarto YAML front matter in the first raw cell. Project `_quarto.yml` or directory `_metadata.yml` can provide the same document settings.

## Configure the notebook

In JupyterLab, create a raw cell at the top of the notebook and enter:

```{.yaml filename="First raw cell"}
---
title: Notebook app
filters:
  - gradio
execute:
  enabled: false
---
```

A [raw YAML front matter cell](https://quarto.org/docs/tools/jupyter-lab.html){target="_blank"} supplies Quarto document metadata without becoming Python source. `execute.enabled: false` preserves the notebook code cells for browser execution during the published render.

Add a Python code cell:

```{.python filename="Python code cell"}
import gradio as gr

def greet(name):
    return f"Hello {name}!"

gr.Interface(greet, "textbox", "textbox").launch()
```

## Render the notebook

From the notebook directory, run:

```{.bash filename="Terminal"}
quarto preview notebook-gradio.ipynb
```

The rendered HTML page starts the app in the browser. The same launch-cell boundary applies to notebook cells. Definitions before `.launch()` join the current app source, and source after a launch begins the next app.

<iframe src="./notebook-gradio.html" title="Jupyter notebook rendered with an embedded quarto-gradio app" width="100%" height="500px"></iframe>

Open the [rendered notebook example](notebook-gradio.html){target="_blank"} or <a href="./notebook-gradio.ipynb" download>download its notebook source</a>.

## Develop locally

You can also run cells in a local Jupyter kernel while authoring. That local environment and the browser environment are different:

- The local kernel uses your installed Python and Gradio packages.
- The published page uses Gradio Lite 5.45.0 and Pyodide 0.27.3.

Keep the source within APIs supported by the frozen browser runtime. Verify the rendered app after local notebook execution succeeds.

The filter replaces the launch cell's rendered output with its source cell and embedded app. Saved notebook outputs attached to that launch cell do not appear in the published page.

See [How quarto-gradio Works](../../concepts/how-it-works/) for source segmentation and [Runtime and Trust](../../concepts/runtime/) for version compatibility.
